dedupe_keys.name: anima rotterdam the hague airport case study 2021

description: Roalt Aalmoes publishes survey results from the 2021 Rotterdam The Hague Airport evaluation of an alternative runway-06 departure procedure. Zenodo lists an Excel workbook, text README and workshop presentation under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. Participants rated the annoyance of original and alternative routes at measured locations; the workbook retains raw scores, order-balanced version coding, averages and standard deviations. These responses can calibrate or check noise-exposure and airport-route planning simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this route-evaluation dataset. The page does not establish a representative sample of all residents or a final decision to change flight paths. Scores are subjective observations, not aircraft trajectories or acoustic levels. The PDF presentation was not downloaded, and participant-level responses or reported effects were not independently checked.
